chunks: He created man and surely know what misdoubts arise in their hearts; for We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

key_terms.حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ: The jugular vein / Cord of the vein

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by God being closer than the jugular vein?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm God's omniscience not just of actions but of the subtlest internal inclinations (waswasa) before they manifest as deeds. The metaphor of proximity to the 'jugular vein' (habl al-warid) underscores a dual reality: God is intimately close to guide and judge, yet this closeness also implies the immediacy of divine presence in the human soul's deepest recesses.
